goal.en: Make a retro concert poster with a striped sun, a lens flare and glowing type.
goal.zh: 做一张复古演唱会海报，有条纹太阳、镜头光晕和发光的标题字。

say.en: Fill the night sky and add haze
say.zh: 铺好夜空底色并加上雾气

steps.a: from: #0d0826, to: #4a1258, angle: 90, style: linear
layer: $sky.layer, name: Sky
foreground: #000000, background: #b04fc8
name: Haze
seed: 7
layer: $haze.layer, blend: Screen, opacity: 0.35

say.zh: 画出带条纹的发光太阳

steps.a: kind: ellipse, rect: 4 items, fill: {…}, name: Sun
kind: rect, rect: 4 items, addTo: $sun.layer, op: subtract
kind: rect, rect: 4 items, addTo: $sun.layer, op: subtract
kind: rect, rect: 4 items, addTo: $sun.layer, op: subtract
kind: rect, rect: 4 items, addTo: $sun.layer, op: subtract
layer: $sun.layer, color: #ff5fa2, opacity: 60, size: 80, spread: 4

say.en: Add the horizon and a perspective grid
say.zh: 加上地平线和透视网格

steps.a: kind: rect, rect: 4 items, fill: {…}, name: Horizon
name: Grid
kind: line, from: 0, 880, to: 1000, 880, weight: 3, fill: #ff4fa8
kind: line, from: 0, 905, to: 1000, 905, weight: 2, fill: #ff4fa8
kind: line, from: 0, 945, to: 1000, 945, weight: 2, fill: #ff4fa8
kind: line, from: 0, 1010, to: 1000, 1010, weight: 2, fill: #ff4fa8
kind: line, from: 0, 1110, to: 1000, 1110, weight: 2, fill: #ff4fa8
kind: line, from: 0, 1260, to: 1000, 1260, weight: 2, fill: #ff4fa8
kind: line, from: 500, 880, to: 500, 1400, weight: 2, fill: #ff4fa8
kind: line, from: 440, 880, to: 140, 1400, weight: 2, fill: #ff4fa8
kind: line, from: 560, 880, to: 860, 1400, weight: 2, fill: #ff4fa8
kind: line, from: 380, 880, to: -220, 1400, weight: 2, fill: #ff4fa8
kind: line, from: 620, 880, to: 1220, 1400, weight: 2, fill: #ff4fa8
layer: $grid.layer, opacity: 0.45

say.en: Render a lens flare as stage light
say.zh: 渲染镜头光晕当作舞台灯光

steps.a: name: Stage Light
layer: $flare.layer, target: $grid.layer, position: above
contents: color, color: #000000
centerX: 0.5, centerY: 0.628, brightness: 70, lens: prime105
layer: $flare.layer, blend: Screen, opacity: 0.8

say.en: Set the headline, lineup and date
say.zh: 排好标题、演出阵容和日期

steps.a: x: 500, y: 200, text: NEON TIDES, font: Bricolage Grotesque, weight: 800
layer: $headline.layer, color: #ff3fa4, opacity: 80, size: 30
x: 500, y: 258, text: LIVE AT HARBOR HALL, font: Inter, weight: 600
name: Lineup
x: 500, y: 1030, text: with Velvet Static · Lumen …, font: Inter
kind: line, from: 400, 1080, to: 600, 1080, weight: 2, fill: #ff6f91
x: 500, y: 1170, text: SAT 14 MARCH, font: Bricolage Grotesque
x: 500, y: 1232, text: DOORS 19:30  ·  SHOW 21:00, font: Inter
x: 500, y: 1330, text: tickets at harborhall.examp…, font: Inter
